translations.web: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
translations.bsb: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
translations.kjv: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure
translations.asv: The works of Jehovah are great, Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
